sql_templates.description: Select sectors with improving breadth and Stage 2 participation.
sql_templates.name: sector_breadth_ranking
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS max_date FROM breadth.sector_daily), 
sectors_with_breadth AS (
  SELECT 
    sd.sector, 
    sd.pct_above_50dma, 
    sd.change_5d, 
    sd.breadth_signal, 
    ma.stage2_pct 
  FROM 
    breadth.sector_daily sd 
  JOIN 
    breadth.ma_pct_above ma 
  ON 
    sd.snapshot_date = ma.snapshot_date 
  JOIN 
    scores.stage_snapshots ss 
  ON 
    sd.sector = ss.sector 
  WHERE 
    sd.snapshot_date = (SELECT max_date FROM latest_snapshot) 
    AND ss.stage = 'STAGE_2'
    AND ma.stage2_pct > 50
)
SELECT 
  sector, 
  MAX(pct_above_50dma) AS max_pct_above_50dma, 
  MAX(change_5d) AS max_change_5d, 
  MAX(stage2_pct) AS max_stage2_pct 
FROM 
  sectors_with_breadth 
GROUP BY 
  sector 
ORDER BY 
  max_stage2_pct DESC, 
  max_change_5d DESC 
LIMIT 5;
